featureComponentReview.read: Useful but no longer the headline gap
featureComponentReview.evidence: The official as-of record baseline is 45% vs model 55% when they disagree. Current model has recent form, but no explicit W-L ratio feature.
When striking is the top weighted component: n=151, model 68%, Brier 0.208.
When grappling is the top weighted component: n=17, model 71%, directional component accuracy 56%.
Submission enters style pressure and method tendency, but it is not isolated in the winner model diagnostics yet.
Activity affects form through layoff shrinkage; reach, stance, and age are not explicit winner-model features in outcome-v0.2.
More-experience baseline is 40%, so raw fight count is not the record signal to chase.
No missing flags: 63%, missing flags: 71%. Missing stats currently fall back to UFC-average defaults, but aggregate missing-data rows did not underperform here.

featureComponentReview.read: Do not blanket-penalize thin history yet
featureComponentReview.evidence: Thin-history fights: 72%, no thin-history fights: 64%. Mid-confidence calibration is the concern, not thin-history accuracy overall.

recommendations.change: Keep v0.2 current while validating more data
recommendations.why: The corrected official as-of baseline is weaker than v0.2 on all-fight accuracy and Brier, and no v0.3 experiment has clearly improved both metrics.
recommendations.expectedEffect: Avoids promoting a noisy variant from one historical sample while preserving the current public model behavior.
recommendations.risk: Model improvement slows down until the next controlled validation pass.
recommendations.howToTest: Re-run this same report after additional completed-event validation or an out-of-sample holdout.
recommendations.metricToImprove: Winner accuracy and Brier against leakage-safe baselines.

recommendations.why: As-of record still carries useful signal in some buckets, but the legacy 71% profile-record baseline is deprecated and should not be optimized against.
recommendations.expectedEffect: Find a conservative way to use record signal without turning the model into a simple record picker.
recommendations.risk: Could overvalue padded records or weak schedules.
recommendations.howToTest: Run diagnostic-only record-ratio and blend variants against the same corpus plus a holdout before promotion.
recommendations.metricToImprove: Brier, winner accuracy, and same/similar-record bucket performance.

recommendations.why: The 60-70 and 70-80 buckets are overconfident while the 80%+ bucket is strong.
recommendations.expectedEffect: Improve Brier and calibration without flattening the best high-confidence calls.
recommendations.risk: May make useful 60-70 calls look too timid if applied too broadly.
recommendations.howToTest: Apply a diagnostic-only shrink to 60-80% outputs and compare calibration gap, Brier, and winner accuracy.
recommendations.metricToImprove: Brier score and calibration gap in 60-80% buckets.

recommendations.change: Require stronger stat evidence for record-contrarian calls
recommendations.why: Some contrarian calls remain weak even after replacing the legacy baseline with the official as-of baseline.
recommendations.expectedEffect: Keeps contrarian calls, but only when component agreement is broad enough.
recommendations.risk: Can turn the model into a record follower if threshold is too blunt.
recommendations.howToTest: Create a diagnostic-only rule: when the official as-of record baseline disagrees, require multiple components to favor the model side; compare misses saved vs wins lost.

recommendations.change: Hold method-model tuning until winner calibration stabilizes
recommendations.why: Method accuracy improved, but method direction is conditioned on noisy winner probabilities.
recommendations.expectedEffect: Avoids chasing method noise before the main probability layer is trustworthy.
recommendations.risk: Method may remain secondary and underoptimized for another cycle.
recommendations.howToTest: After winner calibration changes, re-run method-by-top-method and winner-correct/wrong splits.
recommendations.metricToImprove: Method accuracy without hurting winner Brier.

doNotChangeYet: Do not tune model weights or formulas in this pass.
